card.name: Clefairy Doll BS 70
card.text: Clefairy Doll TRAINER Play Clefairy Doll as if it were a Basic Pokémon. While in play, Clefairy Doll counts as a Pokémon (instead of a Trainer card.) Clefairy Doll has no attacks, can't retreat, and can't be Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned. If Clefairy Doll is Knocked Out, it doesn't count as a Knocked Out Pokémon. At any time during tyour turn before your attack, you may discard Clefairy Doll.

card.name: Computer Search BS 71
card.text: Computer Search TRAINER Discard 2 of the other cards from your hand in order to search your deck for any card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

card.name: Devolution Spray BS 72
card.text: Devolution Spray TRAINER Choose 1 of your own Pokémon in play and a Stage of Evolution. Discard all Evolution cards of that Stage or higher attached to that Pokémon. That Pokémon is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or anything else that might be the result of an attack (just as if you had evolved it).

card.name: Impostor Professor Oak BS 73
card.text: Impostor Professor Oak TRAINER Your opponent shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck, then draws 7 cards.

card.name: Item Finder BS 74
card.text: Item Finder TRAINER Discard 2 of the other cards from your hand in order to put a Trainer card from your discard pile into your hand.

card.name: Lass BS 75
card.text: Lass TRAINER You and your opponent show each other your hands, then shuffle all the Trainer cards from your hands into your decks.

card.name: Pokémon Breeder BS 76
card.text: Pokémon Breeder TRAINER Put a Stage 2 Evolution card from your hand on the matching Basic Pokémon. You can only play this card when you would be allowed to evolve that Pokémon anyway.

card.name: Pokémon Trader BS 77
card.text: Pokémon Trader TRAINER Trade 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards in your hand for 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards from your deck. Show both cards to your opponent. Shuffle your deck afterward.

card.name: Scoop Up BS 78
card.text: Scoop Up TRAINER Choose 1 of your own Pokémon in play and return its Basic Pokémon card to your hand. (Discard all cards attached to that card.)

card.name: Super Energy Removal BS 79
card.text: Super Energy Removal TRAINER Discard 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your own Pokémon in order to choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and up to 2 Energy cards attached to it. Discard those Energy cards.

card.name: Defender BS 80
card.text: Defender TRAINER Attach Defender to 1 of your Pokémon. At the end of your opponent's next turn, discard Defender. Damage done to that Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

card.name: Energy Retrieval BS 81
card.text: Energy Retrieval TRAINER Trade 1 of the other cards in your hand for up to 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile.

card.name: Full Heal BS 82
card.text: Full Heal TRAINER, ITEM Your Active Pokémon is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.

card.name: Maintenance BS 83
card.text: Maintenance TRAINER Shuffle 2 of the other cards from your hand into your deck in order to draw a card.

card.name: PlusPower BS 84
card.text: PlusPower TRAINER Attach PlusPower to your Active Pokémonn. At the end of your turn, discard PlusPower. If this Pokémon's attack does damage to the defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), the attack does 10 more damage to the Defending Pokémon.

card.name: Pokémon Center BS 85
card.text: Pokémon Center TRAINER Remove all damage counters from all of your own Pokémon with damage counters on them, then discard all Energy cards attached to those Pokémon.

card.name: Pokémon Flute BS 86
card.text: Pokémon Flute TRAINER Choose 1 Basic Pokémon card from your opponent's discard pile and put it onto his or her Bench. (You can't play Pokémon Flute if your opponent's Bench is full.)

card.name: Pokédex BS 87
card.text: Pokédex TRAINER Look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck and rearrange them as you like.

card.name: Professor Oak BS 88
card.text: Professor Oak TRAINER Discard your hand, then draw 7 cards.

card.name: Revive BS 89
card.text: Revive TRAINER Put 1 Basic Pokémon card from your discard pile onto your Bench. Put damage counters on that Pokémon equal to half its HP (rounded down to the nearest 10). (You can't play Revive if your Bench is full.)

card.name: Super Potion BS 90
card.text: Super Potion TRAINER Discard 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your own Pokémon in order to remove up to 4 damage counters from that Pokémon.

card.name: Bill BS 91
card.text: Bill TRAINER, ITEM Draw 2 cards.

card.name: Energy Removal BS 92
card.text: Energy Removal TRAINER Choose 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and discard it.

card.name: Gust of Wind BS 93
card.text: Gust of Wind TRAINER Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with his or her Active Pokémon.

card.name: Potion BS 94
card.text: Potion TRAINER, ITEM Remove up to 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon.

card.name: Switch BS 95
card.text: Switch TRAINER, ITEM Switch 1 of your Benched Pokémon with your Active Pokémon.

card.name: Computer Search BS2 101
card.text: Computer Search TRAINER Discard 2 of the other cards from your hand in order to search your deck for any card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

card.name: Imposter Professor Oak BS2 102
card.text: Imposter Professor Oak TRAINER Your opponent shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck, then draws 7 cards.

card.name: Item Finder BS2 103
card.text: Item Finder TRAINER Discard 2 of the other cards from your hand in order to put a Trainer card from your discard pile into your hand.

card.name: Lass BS2 104
card.text: Lass TRAINER You and your opponent show each other your hands, then shuffle all the trainer cards from your hands into your decks.

card.name: Pokémon Breeder BS2 105
card.text: Pokémon Breeder TRAINER Put a Stage 2 Evolution card from your hand on the matching Basic Pokémon. You can only play this card when you would be allowed to evolve that Pokémon anyway.

card.name: Pokémon Trader BS2 106
card.text: Pokémon Trader TRAINER Trade 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards in your hand for 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards from your deck. Show both cards to your opponent. Shuffle your deck afterward.

card.name: Scoop Up BS2 107
card.text: Scoop Up TRAINER Choose 1 of your own Pokémon in play and return its Basic Pokémon card to your hand. (Discard all cards attached to that card.)

card.name: Super Energy Removal BS2 108
card.text: Super Energy Removal TRAINER Discard 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your own Pokémon in order to choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and up to 2 Energy cards attached to it. Discard those Energy cards.

card.name: Defender BS2 109
card.text: Defender TRAINER Attach Defender to 1 of your Pokémon. At the end of your opponent's next turn, discard Defender. Damage done to that Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

card.name: Energy Retrieval BS2 110
card.text: Energy Retrieval TRAINER Trade 1 of other cards in your hand for up to 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile.

card.name: Full Heal BS2 111
card.text: Full Heal TRAINER, ITEM Your Active Pokémon is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.

card.name: Maintenance BS2 112
card.text: Maintenance TRAINER Shuffle 2 of the other cards from your hand into your deck in order to draw a card.

card.name: PlusPower BS2 113
card.text: PlusPower TRAINER Attach PlusPower to your Active Pokémonn. At the end of your turn, discard PlusPower. If this Pokémon's attack does damage to the defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), the attack does 10 more damage to the Defending Pokémon.

card.name: Pokémon Center BS2 114
card.text: Pokémon Center TRAINER Remove all damage counters from all of your own Pokémon with damage counters on them, then discard all Energy cards attached to those Pokémon.

card.name: Pokédex BS2 115
card.text: Pokédex TRAINER Look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck and rearrange them as you like.

card.name: Professor Oak BS2 116
card.text: Professor Oak TRAINER Discard your hand, then draw 7 cards.

card.name: Super Potion BS2 117
card.text: Super Potion TRAINER Discard 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your own Pokémon in order to remove up to 4 damage counters from that Pokémon.

card.name: Bill BS2 118
card.text: Bill TRAINER, ITEM Draw 2 cards.

card.name: Energy Removal BS2 119
card.text: Energy Removal TRAINER Choose 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and discard it.

card.name: Gust of Wind BS2 120
card.text: Gust of Wind TRAINER Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with his or her Active Pokémon.

card.name: Poké Ball BS2 121
card.text: Poké Ball TRAINER Flip a coin. If heads, you may search your deck for any Basic Pokémon or Evolution card. Show that card to your opponent, then put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

card.name: Potion BS2 122
card.text: Potion TRAINER Remove up to 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon.

card.name: Switch BS2 123
card.text: Switch TRAINER Switch 1 of your Benched Pokémon with your Active Pokémon.

Either way, return the card to your hand.

card.name: Erika G1 100

card.text: Lt. Surge TRAINER You can play this card only if you have at least 1 Basic Pokémon card in your hand. Put a Basic Pokémon card from your hand into play as your Active Pokémon. Put your old Active Pokémon onto your Bench. (You can't play this card if your Bench is full.)

card.name: Misty G1 102
card.text: Misty TRAINER Discard 2 of the other cards in your hand in order to play this card. card.name: Secret Mission G1 118
card.text: Secret Mission TRAINER Look at your opponent's hand. Then, you may discard as many other cards as you want from your hand and draw that many cards.

card.name: Tickling Machine G1 119
card.text: Tickling Machine TRAINER Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent sets aside all the cards in his or her hand face down. Nobody may look at those cards. At the end of your opponent's next turn, your opponent puts those cards back into his or her hand. If tails, your turn ends immediately (you can't attack this turn).

card.text: Vermilion City Gym TRAINER, STADIUM Whenever a player attacks with a Pokémon with Lt. Surge in its name, he or she may flip a coin. card.name: Blaine's Quiz #2 G2 111
card.text: Blaine's Quiz #2 TRAINER, NOT_IMPLEMENTED Put a card from your hand face down in front of you. Your opponent guesses whether it is an Energy card, a Trainer card, or a Pokémon (Basic or Evolution) card. Flip the card over. If your opponent guessed right, he or she draws 2 cards. If your opponent guessed wrong, you draw 2 cards. Either way, return the card to your hand.

card.name: Blaine's Quiz #3 G2 112
card.text: Blaine's Quiz #3 TRAINER, NOT_IMPLEMENTED Put a Basic Pokémon or Evolution card from your hand face down in front of you and tell your opponent the name of an attack of that card. Your opponent guesses the name of that card. Flip the card over. If your opponent guessed right, he or she draws 3 cards. If your opponent guessed wrong, you draw 3 cards. Either way, return the card to your hand.

card.text: Item Finder TRAINER You may choose to Discard 1 card from your hand in order to search your discard pile for a Supporter card. Show it to your opponent and put it into your hand. Or,you may choose to Discard 2 cards from your hand in order to search your discard pile for a Trainer card (excluding Supporter cards). Show it to your opponent and put it into your hand.

card.name: Lass MODBS2 104
card.text: Lass TRAINER If you have 5 or more Prize cards left, you can't play this card. You and your opponent show each other your hands, then shuffle all the Trainer cards from your hands into your decks. If any number of Lass are already in your discard pile, you can't play this card.

card.name: Pokémon Breeder MODBS2 105
card.text: Pokémon Breeder TRAINER Put a Stage 2 Evolution card from your hand on the matching Basic Pokémon. You can only play this card when you would be allowed to evolve that Pokémon anyway.

card.name: Pokémon Trader MODBS2 106
card.text: Pokémon Trader TRAINER Trade 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards in your hand for 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards from your deck. Show both cards to your opponent. Shuffle your deck afterward.

card.name: Scoop Up MODBS2 107
card.text: Scoop Up TRAINER Choose 1 of your own Pokémon in play and return its Basic Pokémon card to your hand. (Discard all cards attached to that card.)

card.name: Defender MODBS2 109
card.text: Defender TRAINER Attach Defender to 1 of your Pokémon (excluding [M] Pokémon). At the end of your opponent's next turn, discard Defender. Damage done to that Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

card.name: Energy Retrieval MODBS2 110
card.text: Energy Retrieval TRAINER Trade 1 of the other cards in your hand for up to 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile.

card.name: Full Heal MODBS2 111
card.text: Full Heal TRAINER Remove all Special Conditions from your Active Pokémon.

card.name: Maintenance MODBS2 112
card.text: Maintenance TRAINER Shuffle 2 of the other cards from your hand into your deck in order to draw a card.

card.name: PlusPower MODBS2 113
card.text: PlusPower TRAINER Attach PlusPower to your Active Pokémon (excluding [D] Pokémon). At the end of your turn, discard PlusPower. If this Pokémon's attack does damage to the defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), the attack does 10 more damage to the Defending Pokémon.

card.name: Pokémon Center MODBS2 114
card.text: Pokémon Center TRAINER Remove all damage counters from 1 of your own Pokémon, then discard all Energy cards attached to those Pokémon.

card.name: Pokédex MODBS2 115
card.text: Pokédex TRAINER Look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck and rearrange them as you like.

card.name: Professor Oak MODBS2 116
card.text: Professor Oak TRAINER, SUPPORTER Discard your hand, then draw 7 cards.

card.name: Super Potion MODBS2 117
card.text: Super Potion TRAINER Discard 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your own Pokémon in order to remove up to 4 damage counters from that Pokémon.

card.name: Bill MODBS2 118
card.text: Bill TRAINER Draw 2 cards.

card.name: Energy Removal MODBS2 119
card.text: Energy Removal TRAINER Choose 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and discard it.

card.name: Gust of Wind MODBS2 120
card.text: Gust of Wind TRAINER Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with his or her Active Pokémon.

card.name: Poké Ball MODBS2 121
card.text: Poké Ball TRAINER Flip a coin. If heads, you may search your deck for any Basic Pokémon or Evolution card. Show that card to your opponent, then put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

card.name: Potion MODBS2 122
card.text: Potion TRAINER Remove up to 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon.

card.name: Switch MODBS2 123
card.text: Switch TRAINER Switch 1 of your Benched Pokémon with your Active Pokémon.

card.text: Blaine TRAINER During this turn, instead of attached your free Energy card, you may instead attach 2 [R] Energy cards to 1 of your Pokémon with Blaine in its name. (Playing additional copies of this card this turn has no effect.)

card.text: Brock's Protection TRAINER Attach Brock's Protection to 1 of your Pokémon with Brock in its name. Energy cards attached to that Pokémon can't be removed by your opponent's attacks or Trainer cards (except G-SPEC cards). card.name: Chaos Gym MODG2 102
card.text: Chaos Gym TRAINER, STADIUM Whenever a player plays a Trainer card other than a Stadium card, he or she flips a coin. If heads, that player plays that card normally. If tails, the player can't play that card. If the card isn't put into play, the player's opponent may use that card instead, if he or she does everything required in order to play that card (like discarding cards). Either way, the card goes to its owner's discard pile.

card.text: Erika's Kindness TRAINER Remove 2 damage counters from each Pokémon (excluding Pokémon ex) (yours and your opponent's) with any damage counters on it. If a Pokémon has just 1 damage counter, remove it.

card.text: Giovanni TRAINER Choose 1 of your Pokémon in play with Giovanni in its name. For the rest of your turn, you may evolve that Pokémon even if you just played or evolved it this turn or if this is your first turn. This effect also applies to the Pokémon it evolves into.

card.name: Giovanni's Last Resort MODG2 105
card.text: Giovanni's Last Resort TRAINER Remove all damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon with Giovanni in its name. Then discard your hand.

card.name: Koga MODG2 106
card.text: Koga TRAINER If an attack from a Pokémon with Koga in its name does damage to a Defending Pokémon this turn, that Pokémon is then Poisoned.

card.name: Lt. Surge's Secret Plan MODG2 107
card.text: Lt. Surge's Secret Plan TRAINER, NOT_IMPLEMENTED Put 1 card from your hand face down onto your Bench. (You can't play this card if your Bench is full.) Treat that card as a Basic Pokémon as long as it's face down. Flip the card if either player ever needs to know what it is in order to use an attack, a Poké-Power, or a Trainer card. Flip the card if it ever uses an attack or Poké-Power, evolves, retreats, is damaged by an attack, or is otherwise affected by an attack. At any time during your turn, you may flip the card over. When you flip that card over, if it isn't a Basic Pokémon, discard it and all cards attached to it.

card.text: Misty's Wish TRAINER Look at 1 of your Prize cards. Then, ask your opponent if you may switch that card with 1 of the cards in your hand. If your opponent accepts and if you have any other cards in your hand, switch those cards. If your opponent declines, return the Prize card face down and draw a card.

card.text: Blaine's Quiz #2 TRAINER, NOT_IMPLEMENTED Put a card from your hand face down in front of you. Your opponent guesses whether it is an Energy card, a Trainer card, or a Pokémon (Basic or Evolution) card. Flip the card over. If your opponent guessed right, he or she draws 2 cards. If your opponent guessed wrong, you draw 2 cards. Either way, return the card to your hand.

card.name: Challenge! MODIMP 222
card.text: Challenge! TRAINER Ask your opponent if he or she accepts your challenge. If your opponent declines (or if both Benches are full), draw 2 cards. If your opponent accepts, each of you searches your decks for any number of Basic Pokémon cards (excluding Pokémon-ex) and puts them face down onto your Benches. (A player can't do this if his or her Bench is full.) When you both have finished, shuffle your decks and turn those cards face up.

card.name: Crystal Guard MODIMP 223
card.text: Crystal Guard TRAINER, POKEMON_TOOL As long as the Pokémon Crystal Guard is attached to (excluding Pokémon-ex) is 1 of your Benched Pokémon, ignore all effects of attacks and Poké-Powers (including damage) done to that Pokémon by your opponent's Pokémon

card.name: Relic Hunter MODIMP 224
card.text: Relic Hunter TRAINER Search your discard pile for up to 2 Stadium cards, show them to your opponent, and shuffle them into your deck.

card.text: Lost Expedition TRAINER You may play 2 Lost Expedition at the same time. If you play 1 Lost Expedition, draw a card. If you play 2 Lost Expedition, search your deck for any 1 card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

card.name: Underground Expedition MODIMP 226
card.text: Underground Expedition TRAINER, SUPPORTER Look at the bottom 4 cards of your deck. Put 2 of the cards you find there into your hand. Return the remaining cards to the bottom of your deck in any order you like.

card.name: Energy Restore MODIMP 227

card.name: Energy Search MODIMP 228

card.name: Energy Retrieval MODIMP 230

card.name: Super Energy Retrieval MODIMP 231

card.name: Energy Removal MODIMP 232

card.name: Super Energy Removal MODIMP 233

card.name: Tool Scrapper MODIMP 234

If the Pokémon Rocket's Energy RF is attached to is a Pokémon-ex, discard Rocket's Energy RF.
